extracted.syntax_error_details: Missing semicolons after the border declarations C01 through C06; each border definition should end with a semicolon after the closing brace.

designed.mesh_code_rationale: Added the missing semicolon after each border declaration's closing brace to repair the FreeFEM syntax. The geometry, edge parameterisation, labels, and structure of the extracted mesh are preserved exactly.
designed.domain_description: 2D cantilever-like rectangular domain [0,2] x [0,1]. The left edge is the clamped boundary (label 4), a short segment on the right edge is the loaded boundary (label 2), and the remaining boundary portions are traction-free (label 1).
